# routeros_ip_media (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ip_media" "media" {
  path             = "example"
  allowed_hostname = "example"
  allowed_ip       = "192.0.2.1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Path on the router's file system where the media content is stored, e.g. `usb1/movies`.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `allowed_hostname` (String) Restricts access to this media server to the listed client hostnames.
- `allowed_ip` (String) Restricts access to this media server to the listed client IP addresses.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `friendly_name` (String) Name under which the DLNA server is advertised on the network.
- `interface` (String) Network interface the DLNA server is served on.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/ip/media get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_ip_media.media "*1"
```
